Santokh Matharu is the most insensitive and rude doctor I’ve ever had the displeasure of talking to. For someone who’s meant to be there for people in a medical or mental health emergency he is quite simply void of feelings, you’re nothing but a number to him and it’s such a shame the lovely times I’ve had with the receptionists and nurses in this GP are overlooked by his horrendous attitude. He is not inclusive to anyone and I’m surprised he’s been a doctor for as long as he has because I am having to leave this GP surgery and look elsewhere because of him. Each time I have had to speak to him I have left in tears with more questions than before.

A highlight would be him telling a diabetic that testing their blood was a waste of time ???
